name: Verkada Camera Alerts
shortDescription: MCP server for querying Verkada camera security alerts with support for filtering by notification type and time range.

rawRecord.name: Verkada Camera Alerts
rawRecord.short_description: MCP server for querying Verkada camera security alerts with support for filtering by notification type and time range.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: An MCP server built with FastMCP that integrates with Verkada's camera security system to provide AI-powered alert management. Offers a single tool for querying camera events within specified time ranges, supporting filtering by notification types including person detection, license plate matching, tampering, crowd detection, and motion alerts. Deployable on Render hosting.
